[IERR.2.3.1] These apply anywhere. `DS_ERR_INVAL` is the
"caller passed something wrong" bucket — NULL
where non-NULL required, out-of-range value.
A handle another engine handed out, or a fact
handle whose fact is not live, is not in it: passing one is
undefined behaviour, and no status reports it
([IDAT.1.6]). `DS_ERR_STATE` is the
"operation isn't legal right now" bucket — pump
called during destroy, a fact asserted before the
`.dsc` is loaded, etc.
